question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87d08868c0c43b852652b7476dea0bca12694a3abb58bbabdf65d3a70360b090.png]
solution:

⇒The given figure (pointing arrow) in the box is rotating in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34062111f0587c8e065e28898f91a7a0c9bcf01a2be957790b0024a37ec8b07b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option-(2)".
